title: uniqueItems over a hundred thousand items finds the one duplicate, the last, within a bound no quadratic check fits
notes: A check comparing every pair would make about 5,000,000,000 comparisons here, past the step's CPU bound. internal/schema's TestUniqueItemsMillion runs, in process, the most items schema-work's default lets one validation see, and shows the million ADR-009 D17 item 6 names refused by schema-work. Its generated files are written by internal/vectorgen (go test ./internal/vectorgen -run TestSchemaCorpus -args -update), whose test reproduces them.
